instruction_and_task: Imagine it happened differently. Start with *If I*: I didn't see the sign, so I parked there and got a fine.
note: the learner types a whole sentence

instruction_and_task: I didn't learn English at school. If I ___ it then, I ___ fluent now. (learn / be)
note: the learner types the missing word(s); several gaps: one answer per gap

instruction_and_task: Choose the correct option: 'Where do you work?' She asked me ___.
'Congratulations, Jo! You've finally passed the exam!' I congratulated Jo ___ passing the exam.
note: the learner drags one card into each gap

instruction_and_task: Say what my sister did, in one sentence. My sister said to me: 'You really should see a doctor about that cough.'
note: the learner types a whole sentence

instruction_and_task: Ask politely. Start with *Could you tell me*: Why hasn't the order arrived?
note: the learner types a whole sentence

instruction_and_task: Choose the correct option: I use an app ___ edits my videos.
Join with *which*: We visited a museum. It has old cars.
note: the learner types a whole sentence

instruction_and_task: Join with *which*: The app helps me learn new words. It is free.
note: the learner types a whole sentence

instruction_and_task: Match each beginning with its ending.
Choose the correct option: He ___ to the party tonight.
Rewrite with *might*: Perhaps the concert tickets are sold out.
note: the learner types a whole sentence

instruction_and_task: Match each sentence with its meaning.
Make a sentence with *decide*: I will go home early.
note: the learner types a whole sentence
